test_assertAlmostEqual: test that two float values are almost equal within a specified delta or decimal places
test_assertRaises: test that a block of code raises an expected exception using the assertRaises context manager
test_assertEqual: test that two objects are equal and optionally provide a custom error message on failure
test_assertEmpty: test that a sized collection like a list or dict is empty with an optional message
test_assertIsInstance: test that an object is an instance of a given type
